'''Zaccharie Risacher''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|z|æ|k|ər|i|_|ˌ|r|iː|z|ɑː|ˈ|ʃ|eɪ}} {{respell|ZAK|ər|ee|_|REE|zah|SHAY}} {{IPA-fr|zakaʁi ʁizaʃe}};<ref>{{cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R0MmtX8PYWE |title=2 minutes avec Zaccharie Risacher |publisher=[[JL Bourg Basket |JL Bourg]] |date=17 June 2023 |time=00:00:04 |via=[[YouTube]] }}</ref>  born 8 April 2005) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[JL Bourg Basket|JL Bourg]] of the [[LNB Pro A]], on loan from [[ASVEL Basket|ASVEL]].

==Early life==
Risacher was born in [[Málaga]], [[Spain]], where his father, [[Stéphane Risacher]], was playing professional basketball for Club [[Baloncesto Málaga]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.malagahoy.es/unicaja/Zaccharie-Risacher-malagueno-juega-Euroliga_0_1660634276.html|title=Zaccharie Risacher, el malagueño de 16 años que ya juega en Euroliga|work=Málaga Hoy|date=28 February 2022|access-date=23 February 2023|language=Spanish}}</ref> He went on to live three years in Spain and afterward grew up in [[Lyon]] where he played for the small club Tassin in the suburbs of the city.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-06-01 |title=Risacher trying to follow in father's footsteps {{!}} Adidas Next Generation Tournament |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/ngt/news/risacher-trying-to-follow-in-fathers-footsteps/ |access-date=4 April 2024 |website=Euroleague Basketball |language=en-GB}}</ref>

Risacher entered the youth program for [[ASVEL Basket]] in August 2020. He primarily played for the team's club in LNB Espoirs, the French under-21 league.<ref>{{cite web |title=Basket : Zacharie Risacher, phénomène en éclosion à l'ASVEL |url=https://www.sportmag.fr/basket-zacharie-risacher-phenomene-en-eclosion-a-lasvel/}}</ref>

==Professional career==
Risacher made his debut with the senior team in 2021 against [[Metropolitans 92]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lequotidiendusport.fr/zaccharie-risacher-gratter-des-minutes-avec-lasvel/|title=Zaccharie Risacher (ASVEL): "Il ne faut jamais se reposer sur ses lauriers"|work=Le Quotidien du Sport|date=6 February 2022|access-date=22 February 2023|language=French}}</ref> He also made his [[EuroLeague]] debut later in the season on 18 January 2022 in a 75–100 loss to [[AS Monaco Basket|Monaco]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/584013/euroleague-monaco-prend-sa-revanche-sur-lasvel-a-lastroballe/|title=Euroleague: Monaco prend sa revanche sur l’ASVEL à l’Astroballe!|first=Clement|last=Carton|website=BasketEurope.com|date=18 January 2022|access-date=23 February 2023|language=French}}</ref> Risacher also averaged 12.5 points and 4.4 rebounds per game in LNB Espoirs competition.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.malagahoy.es/unicaja/Zaccharie-Risacher-segundo-malagueno-Mundial_0_1698130948.html|title= Zaccharie Risacher, el segundo malagueño en el Mundial sub 17|work=Málaga Hoy|date=2 July 2022|access-date=23 February 2023|language=Spanish}}</ref>

On 16 June 2023, Risacher signed his first professional contract with ASVEL but was immediately loaned to [[JL Bourg Basket|JL Bourg]] for the 2023–24 season.<ref>{{cite web |title=Zaccharie Risacher signs his first pro contract with ASVEL, but is sent out on loan |url=https://basketnews.com/news-190816-zaccharie-risacher-signs-his-first-pro-contract-with-asvel-but-is-sent-out-on-loan.html |website=basketnews.com |access-date=6 January 2024 |date=16 June 2023}}</ref> On 29 November 2023, Risarcher was named to Team France of the [[LNB All-Star Game]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 November 2023 |title=All Star Game LNB 2023 : les All Stars et les participants aux concours sont connus ! |url=https://www.lnb.fr/elite/all-star-game-lnb-2023-les-all-stars-et-les-participants-aux-concours-sont-connus/ |access-date=25 February 2024 |website=Betclic ELITE |language=fr}}</ref>  

Internationally, JL Bourg played in the 2023–24 [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]] where the team was successful and reached the [[2024 EuroCup Finals|finals]]. In April, Risacher was named the [[EuroCup Rising Star]], becoming the second youngest player to win the award at age 19, just a month younger than [[Džanan Musa]] who won the award in [[2017–18 EuroCup Basketball|2018.]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 April 2024 |title=BKT EuroCup Rising Star winner: Zaccharie Risacher, Bourg {{!}} EuroCup |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/eurocup/news/bkt-eurocup-rising-star-winner-zaccharie-risacher-bourg/ |access-date=10 April 2024 |website=Euroleague Basketball |language=en-GB}}</ref> Bourg went on to lose to favored [[Paris Basketball]] in the [[2024 EuroCup Finals]]. 

On 12 May 2024, Risacher was named the [[LNB Pro A Best Young Player|Best Young Player]] of the 2023–24 [[LNB Élite]] season after finishing the season with averages of 10.1 points and 3.8 rebounds in 22 minutes per game.'''<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 May 2024 |title=Trophées LNB 2024 : les lauréats en Betclic ELITE |url=https://www.lnb.fr/elite/trophees-lnb-2024-les-laureats-en-betclic-elite/ |access-date=15 May 2024 |website=Betclic ELITE |language=fr}}</ref>'''<ref>{{Cite web |last=Proballers |title=Zaccharie Risacher, Basketball Player |url=https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/212368/zaccharie-risacher |access-date=15 May 2024 |website=Proballers |language=en}}</ref> 

==National team career==
Risacher played for the [[France men's national under-17 basketball team|France under-17 basketball team]] at the [[2022 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/looking-at-the-future-zaccharie-risacher|title=Looking at the Future: Zaccharie Risacher|first=Ignacio|last=Rissotto|website=[[SI.com]]|date=4 November 2022|access-date=22 February 2023}}</ref> He struggled with consistency during the tournament which culminated by a zero-point, five-turnover performance in the final against Spain.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Next Big Thing: Why is Zaccharie Risacher projected as the #1 pick in the NBA draft? |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/eurobasket/2025/qualifiers/news/next-big-thing-why-is-zaccharie-risacher-projected-as-the-1-pick-in-the-nba-draft |access-date=4 April 2024 |website=FIBA.basketball |language=en}}</ref> He averaged 10.4 points and 4.4 rebounds per game as France won the bronze medal.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Les-bleuets-decrochent-le-bronze-a-la-coupe-du-monde-u17-contre-la-lituanie/1342989|title=Les Bleuets décrochent le bronze à la Coupe du monde U17 contre la Lituanie|work=[[L'Équipe]]|date=10 July 2022|access-date=23 February 2023|language=French}}</ref>

In February 2024, Risacher was selected for the [[France men's national basketball team|France senior team]] for their [[EuroBasket 2025]] qualifying games.<ref name=":0" />

==Player profile==
Playing at [[small forward]], Risacher is regarded as a very efficient catch-and-shoot player as well as a good shooter coming off screens or from mid-range.<ref name=":0" /> His versatility has been praised for his ability to defend both guards and forwards on the perimeter.<ref name=":0" />

==Personal life==
Risacher's father, [[Stéphane Risacher]], played basketball professionally and won a silver medal at the [[2000 Summer Olympics]] with the [[France national basketball team]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.leprogres.fr/sport/2022/02/10/zaccharie-risacher-l-autre-pepite-de-l-asvel|title=EUROLIGUE. Zaccharie Risacher, l'autre pépite de l'Asvel|work=[[Le Progrès]]|date=10 February 2022|access-date=22 February 2023|language=French}}</ref>
